annotations.title: Get SpotCheck Account Entitlement and Status

description: Describes who SpotCheck thinks the caller is and what they can do right now. Returns email (null when anonymous), tier (free, pro or premium), isAnonymous, authMethod (oauth, session, api_key, anonymous or env_override), features (playlistChecking, fullFactorBreakdown, historicalTrends, curatorContacts, cloudMonitoring, maxMonitors), allowance (dailyChecksRemaining and unlimited; usageUnavailable is set when today's count could not be read) and upgradeUrl (null on paid tiers). Use it before other calls to plan: whether check_playlist has checks left today (anonymous 1 a day, Free 3, Pro and Premium unlimited), whether get_curator_contacts and the monitor tools will work (Premium, £14.99/mo), and whether the full factor breakdown is unlocked (Pro, £4.99/mo, or Premium). Takes no arguments, works without signing in, costs nothing and does not use up a check. Read-only and safe to repeat.
name: get_account_status
